papers.mechanism: At fixed intermediate step estimate count; correct count continues. Wrong count restarts from same initial noise, steers early via norm-matched original + gamma*(original-control) denoiser predictions. Control changes target count to observed count. Adaptive variant rechecks once, doubles or halves gamma from count-error direction, runs at most two steered trajectories.

findings.result: Mid-trajectory feedback, restart from same initial noise, conditional stop and one adaptive strength update are already implemented.
FLUX ATHENA-dataset count exact accuracy39.4 to53.6%, mean45.5 to72.5s on360 prompts, seed23; Static48.9%,54.7s.
SD3.5 ATHENA-dataset38.9 to56.1%; SDXL19.7 to34.7%; CountGen onSDXL29.4%.
FLUX CoCoCount Static73.3% exceeds Adaptive70.2%; adaptation is not uniformly dominant.
FLUX/SD3.5 estimation step parameter20, feedback/adaptive steering parameter5, gamma4; SDXL30/10/5. Do not infer total-step count from these parameters.
